we are the first to use ID Modulation in a real-world application, and that we have demonstrated that ID Modulation is a viable technique for embedding sensor data in an RFID timeseries.

ID Modulation is a useful tool for building new applications on top of existing communication protocols, even when the existing protocols were not originally designed for that purpose.
